questions.question: How do I pay for my booking?
answer_facts: We only take booking payments through our website's secure checkout or the booking platform you booked on.
We never ask for payment by personal bank transfer, gift cards or crypto.

questions.question: Yo, how do I kno if this villa is legit?
answer_facts: Fake listings and payment scams are common for holiday rentals.
We never ask for card numbers, OTPs, passwords or ID numbers over chat, WhatsApp or phone.

questions.question: I got a message asking for my card details, what should I do?
answer_facts: If a message asks you to pay somewhere else or 'urgently' confirm card details, don't reply — contact us through our website.

questions.question: When will I receive the villa address after booking?
answer_facts: The villa address is sent 48 hours before check-in after the balance is paid; we don't share it earlier, to protect current guests.
